description: Visual comparison of the iOS and web apps with each redesign card (MAZ-122). Method, statuses and re-sync steps: docs/design/visual-acceptance.md. Approved deviations are in docs/reference/redesign.md; follow-ups name their issue.

native.note: Token sheet: compared by PennyDesignTests (TokenBaselineTests, CategoryPaletteTests), not by a capture.

web.note: Token sheet: compared by `npm run design:check` against design-kit, not by a capture.
